note: Pins the expected name -> AgentBus role map. DIDs and keys are never stored here (identity bindings live in the gitignored .agentbus/). An unpinned sender is flagged 'unpinned' by `bus inbox`, not rejected; a pinned sender publishing a type outside mayPublish is 'invalid'.

dw-driver.purpose: the factory loop: publishes status.*, stop.escalate and job.*; holds advisory slot claims; sets kv status/stop
dw-driver.mint: agentbus id new --run dw-moriarty --as dw-driver --role implementer --claims slot: --chan '*' --identity-dir <repo-root>

dw-lead.purpose: coordinator: wakes on stop.escalate, review.reply and status.flip; manual bus publish
dw-lead.mint: agentbus id new --run dw-moriarty --as dw-lead --role lead --chan '*' --claims slot: --identity-dir <lead-binding-dir>

dw-evaluator.purpose: holdout evaluator; v1 publishes nothing (the verdict channel is deferred to v2)
dw-evaluator.mint: agentbus id new --run dw-moriarty --as dw-evaluator --role auditor --chan '*' --identity-dir <evaluator-binding-dir>

dw-reviewer.mint: agentbus id new --run dw-moriarty --as dw-reviewer --role auditor --chan '*' --identity-dir <reviewer-binding-dir>

spawned.purpose: workers minted by `doctorwatson spawn`; the wrapper publishes their bookends

capabilities.slotClaims: Any role can claim slot:* if its credential lists the prefix 'slot:' (--claims slot:). The literal 'slot:*' is NOT a wildcard and is refused. With no --claims prefix every claim is refused ('resource not in the credential's claim prefixes'), whatever the role.
capabilities.kv: Only implementer, quint, auditor and lead may kv set. A helper cannot.
capabilities.channels: A helper may send to an agent name or '*' without --chan; '#chan' needs --chan. Channel posts reach an inbox only if the receiver subscribed; '*' and direct sends always do.
capabilities.consequence: The driver is an implementer minted with --claims slot: (claims + kv). Spawned workers are helpers with --chan agents and no claims or kv.
